columns.of350_reference_boundaries.csv: One flux row per output time and patch, containing liquid, total, and inferred gas volumetric flux.
columns.of350_reference_global.csv: One all-domain QoI row per output time.
columns.of350_reference_regions.csv: One QoI row per output time and one of the 16 source cellZones; plan_area_m2 is included.

flux.inferred_gas_volume_flux: phi - alphaPhi.liquid; an inferred residual volumetric flux, not a separately written gas mass flux.
flux.sign: OpenFOAM patch-face orientation: positive is outward from the computational domain.

pressure: p field is absolute pressure in Pa (dimensions [1 -1 -2 0 0 0 0]), not p_rgh/gauge pressure.

regression_coordinates.conditional: physical time only after OpenLB physical-time mapping passes
regression_coordinates.primary: mean_top_displacement_m reconstructed from the actual cellDisplacement field
regression_coordinates.secondary_diagnostic: normalized_plate_state from the nominal quintic smoothstep; never substitutes for the actual displacement coordinate

spatial_averaging.gas_dominant: cells with alpha.liquid < 0.01; gas density is recovered from rho_mix = alpha*rho_liquid + (1-alpha)*rho_gas.
spatial_averaging.volume_weighted: sum(q_i * V_i) / sum(V_i), with V_i = 1e-10 m2 * reconstructed local layer height.

velocity: mean_speed_m_s is the volume-weighted mean of |U|; max_speed_m_s is the cell maximum of |U|.
